title: Retained Advisory
headline: Retained Advisory
paragraphs: Most approaches try to solve a single problem, and it is sold to us that this is how it works. Have pain? Take the pill. It solves the pain. Right? Yes, but it really solves the cause of the problem.

I work with you on the cause. Using different dimensions of human experience, our analytical intelligence, our direct experience, and the bodily dimension. Most work is conceptual only, and that is a disservice to you as a human. Our conscious process takes 5% of your brain's capacity; the rest gets done without thought. But in that rest your hunches, insights, and gut feelings live. And often the best decision comes from a mixture of all human faculties.

Our work includes one-on-one conversations, trainings for your nervous system, and, on request, working with your teams and developing custom trainings. You are the primary focus of this work. You are the environment for your organization to thrive, or dive.
